items.title: Cove Point, Freeport Restarts Push US LNG Feedgas Demand to 6-Month High
items.summary: US LNG feedgas demand climbed to a six-month high Tuesday as Cove Point LNG came back from annual maintenance, Freeport LNG returned to a three-train pace and Golden Pass LNG posted its best five-day run since commissioning began.

items.summary: Tight supply, recovering LNG feedgas and a brief northern cooldown in the forecast fueled natural gas futures gains on Tuesday.

items.title: Is There More Fuel for Natural Gas Bulls?
items.summary: US natural gas futures pushed higher Tuesday morning amid declining domestic production and strengthening LNG feedgas demand. Cash prices were mixed, with Appalachian gas rebounding sharply while Waha weakened further.

items.title: Weekly Natural Gas Cash Prices Vary Widely by Region
items.summary: Strong demand in the South countered seasonal weakness on both the East and West coasts in the latest weekly natural gas period, leaving the average national price nearly flat.

items.title: Henry Hub Prices Lag Profitability Mark, but Natural Gas Output Still Strong
items.summary: US natural gas prices remain below levels needed to make drilling profitable for many producers, according to the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City’s third quarter energy survey, even as overall drilling activity remains strong.

items.title: Canada’s Montney Natural Gas Well Productivity Surges
items.summary: The Montney Shale is posting strong productivity gains as drilling technology advances, solidifying its dominance in Canada’s natural gas production, according to a report from the Canada Energy Regulator (CER).
